sentences.text:
Heard Sri Vipin Shukla, Advocate holding brief of Sri Ashish Kumar Mishra, learned counsel for
applicant and learned Aga appearing for the State.

2.  This present application has been filed for seeking quashing of chargesheet dated 23.10.2024 along with summoning order dated 18.03.2025 and entire proceeding of Case No.4558 of 2025 (State Vs. Manoj Kumar Singh Chauhan), arising out of Case Crime No.133 of 2024, under Sections 419, 420, 468, 471 IPC, P.S. Achhalda, District Auraiya, pending in the court of learned Civil Judge (J.D.)/FTC (Crime Against Women), Auraiya.

entities.text: Case No.4558 of 2025 (State Vs. Manoj Kumar Singh Chauhan)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. On perusal of the narration of FIR as well as impugned order and chargesheet, this Court does not find it to be a case where interference of this Court is required.
No such ground appears to be available in the present application, on the basis of which, impugned order along with chargesheet and entire proceedings of the said case, can be set aside.
4. Accordingly, the prayer sought through the instant application, is refused.
5. Lastly, learned counsel for applicant has submitted that liberty may be granted to applicant to surrender before the court concerned and apply for bail to which learned AGA has no objection.

6. In view of the aforesaid, the instant application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court concerned that in case, the applicant surrenders before the court concerned within a period of 15 days from today and apply for bail, his bail application shall be considered and decided expeditiously in accordance with law laid down in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another (2022 SCC OnLine SC 825).
7.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another (2022 SCC OnLine SC 825)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, it is made clear that till 15 days from today, no coercive action shall be taken against applicant herein in pursuance of aforesaid case.

(Saurabh Srivastava,J.) November 6, 2025 Vivek Kr.
